resources.string: Foreground PoC only. Keep this app open during enrollment. Push/background completion is not guaranteed; refresh to recover pending sign-ins.
Paste activation QR text (not a camera scanner)

Developer preparation: enter fresh QR text OR a complete activation code and URL above, then open a page below. Inputs are cleared and held only in native memory. The page requests native enrollment confirmation, not production portal continuation. No activation input is sent to the page.
Clear setup page (does not undo enrollment)
No current page. An expired or interrupted page cannot be replayed.

The controlled page in this app requested enrollment using the fresh activation input prepared natively. Continue sends a real registration through the live MFA SDK. This confirms native enrollment only, not production portal continuation. Keep this app open until completion. Cancel sends no enrollment request.

The controlled browser page requested enrollment using the fresh activation input prepared natively. Continue sends a real registration through the live MFA SDK. This is a sample link, not a verified production portal handoff. Keep this app open until completion, then use Return to setup page or resume the browser tab. Cancel sends no enrollment request.
No pending sign-ins. Refresh after starting a sign-in externally.

Open the sample and refresh to review. No action is available on the lock screen.

Use Set up using this device on the supported Pair your account step. The demo link simulates future AuthUX page UI; both hosts use the same deep link without a JavaScript bridge. Chrome uses the USB-injected button; this WebView signs in separately. Confirm natively, then manually press Next on the website. For Chrome, return to the original browser tab first.
